text:
Ana (infra): FYI Zenith just flagged a staggered release for the APAC H100 allocation — 40 units total, 36 ship on schedule, 4 marked fragile/DOA potential. vendor says customs hold risk for one wave. Need routing + RMA plan.

Kevin (procurement): Can we get the exact AWB/ETA per pallet? air vs sea cost delta? if air, what's uplift $/unit?

Zenith Ops: AWBs: AWB1234567890 (wave A, 20 units) ETA 2025-07-12; AWB1234567891 (wave B, 16 units) ETA 2025-07-18; wave C (4 fragile) currently Q2 hold pending inspection, provisional ETA 2025-07-20. Air uplift estimated +$8k/unit.

Leo (fleet): If wave C delays, we hit padding threshold for apac-gpu-pool on 7/20. Can we stagger deploys so critical clusters get first 24 units? Suggest reserving 12 for burst pools, rest to standard.

Rachel (ops): For the 4 fragile: request photos + serials before handoff. If DOA confirmed we'll need RMA labels with vendor RMA# ZEN-2891. Also need HS code for customs form — what are we declaring?

Zenith Ops: HS code we'll declare is 8471.80.90 (computing machines accessory classification) but shipping broker asked for end-use doc for one consignment — vendor will upload to portal by EOD. Photos and serials attached to manifest: see link https://zenith.example/manifest/AWB1234567892

Sam (sre): Heads-up: if we lose 4 units, our current rolling-canary plan still ok for 99.9% latency, but throughput drops on region-2 by ~12%. Need explicit fallback to eu-burst for non-latency-critical jobs.

Ana (infra): Noted. Kevin — can you authorize air pickup for wave C if vendor confirms DOA on inspection? We'll absorb cost if it keeps scheduled canary. Otherwise we'll accept sea and replan deploy.

Kevin (procurement): I can approve air for up to 2 units (emergency), beyond that need finance signoff. What’s breakeven on customer impact vs $ spent?

Rachel (ops): Estimate impact: 2 units -> minor perf blip, no customer-facing outage. 4 units -> some retry/queueing in region-2 for short windows, may surface as increased 503s on heavy tails.

Zenith Ops: We've pushed for expedited inspection. If cleared by 05:00 UTC tomorrow we can move wave C on the same AWB and ship by air at our discounted uplift ($5.5k/unit). Otherwise default sea roll.

VendorBot: Shipment status changed: AWB1234567891 status -> customs_hold at 2025-07-09T22:14:00Z (ref ZEN-HOLD-91).

Leo (fleet): OK — plan for now: reserve first 24 units to critical clusters, prep eu-burst fallback, Rachel get RMA label template ready and queue finance for potential extra uplift.

Ana (infra): Thanks. Rachel, please link RMA template here when ready. Kevin, ping me once finance responds.

Rachel (ops): RMA template uploaded: https://redwood.share/rma_templates/zenith.json — fill serials in column B and ping me. I'll start the label request with Zen. :thumbsup:

Kevin (procurement): Finance pinged — provisional approval for up to $22k uplift total if vendor confirms DOA. I'll confirm ASAP.

Ana (infra): Great. Keeping thread open — will update when vendor clears inspection or customs release.
